why_needed: needed to reconstruct gas/liquid product split and a full feed basis
preferred_resolution: obtain RSC ESI Table S2 or author-supplied raw table
notes: do not infer from the 650 degC gas-yield endpoint

why_needed: needed to characterize the recovered oil and constrain heavy/aromatic character
preferred_resolution: obtain exact table/ESI; controlled figure digitization only as fallback

why_needed: needed to characterize aromatic content and surrogate choice
preferred_resolution: obtain exact table/ESI; controlled figure digitization only as fallback

why_needed: needed to quantify polar heavy fraction and decide whether associating Heavy treatment is warranted
preferred_resolution: obtain exact table/ESI; controlled figure digitization only as fallback

why_needed: needed to quantify the heaviest/polar fraction and decide if a single nonassociating Heavy surrogate is defensible
preferred_resolution: obtain exact table/ESI; controlled figure digitization only as fallback

why_needed: needed if a gas lump is retained in the numerical fluid
needed to avoid double-counting volatile hydrocarbons between gas and liquid lumps
preferred_resolution: obtain exact ESI gas-composition table and definition of C3+

why_needed: needed to decide whether CO2 belongs in the later fully compositional fluid
notes: CO2 is a reaction product in the conversion experiment; current flow model would treat it as pre-existing if included

why_needed: direct basis needed for C6-C14/C15-C20/C21+ or alternative carbon-number lumping
preferred_resolution: search primary/related supplementary data; otherwise acquire experimental GC/GC-MS/simdist for the same product
notes: most important unresolved gap for physically based L/M/H cuts

why_needed: needed to derive boiling-range pseudo-components and average Tb
preferred_resolution: obtain same-sample simulated-distillation data or measure it
notes: pure-kerogen ACS study may provide secondary trends but cannot replace raw-shale sample data

why_needed: required for petroleum pseudo-component characterization and viscosity validation
preferred_resolution: search additional same-sample characterization or measure density at defined reference T/P
notes: ambient recovered-oil density and in-situ phase density are different quantities

why_needed: required to turn mass fractions into EOS mole fractions and characterize pseudo-components
preferred_resolution: measure or infer from a documented distillation/GC characterization method with uncertainty
notes: do not assign nC10/nC16/squalane MWs before lumping is fixed

why_needed: needed to validate hydrocarbon-rich-phase viscosity closure
preferred_resolution: obtain recovered-oil viscosity versus T/P plus surrogate-component data; later use f-theory/Pedersen validation
notes: target 653 K data are especially important

why_needed: needed to attach experimental uncertainty to product yields/compositions
preferred_resolution: obtain ESI Table S2/Fig S1 and replicate information
notes: main text only states an overall 90-95 percent mass-balance range

why_needed: liquid recovery loses hydrocarbons boiling below about 46 degC; gas and recovered oil therefore require a common mass basis
preferred_resolution: combine measured gas amounts/composition with recovered liquid and explicitly account for low-boiling loss
notes: cannot be reconstructed from SARA alone

why_needed: batch-product SARA/GC after quench is not an equilibrium tie-line measurement at 380 degC and 25 MPa
preferred_resolution: use independent H2O-hydrocarbon VLE/LLE data for EOS calibration; do not fit EOS directly to post-quench SARA
notes: conceptual distinction required throughout later work
